issues.summary: TVM should be preinstalled in the Docker image, not installed at test time.
Need to decide whether main CI should run TVM E2E tests at all, since the risk may be low enough that they aren't needed.
Need to decide how many TVM tests to run and how much CI time is acceptable.
The PR must show that the TVM tests actually pass.
The maintainer needs to understand how many moving parts and dependencies the TVM install involves.
